entries.title: Numbers 12:1
segments: And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had taken. For he had taken a Cushite woman.

entries.title: Numbers 12:2
segments: And they said, Has the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? Has He not also spoken by us? And the LORD heard.

entries.title: Numbers 12:3
segments: (Now the man Moses [was] very meek, more than all the men on the face of the earth.)

entries.title: Numbers 12:4
segments: And the LORD spoke suddenly to Moses and to Aaron and to Miriam, You three come out to the tabernacle of the congregation. And the three came out.

entries.title: Numbers 12:5
segments: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud and stood [in] the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam. And they both came forth.

entries.title: Numbers 12:6
segments: And He said, Hear now My words. If there is a prophet among you, [I] the LORD will make Myself known to him in a vision, and will speak to him in a dream.

entries.title: Numbers 12:7
segments: Not so, My servant Moses. He [is] faithful in all My house.

entries.title: Numbers 12:8
segments: I will speak with him mouth to mouth, even clearly, and not in dark speeches. And he shall behold the likeness of the LORD. Why then were you not afraid to speak against My servant Moses?

entries.title: Numbers 12:9
segments: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them, and He moved.

entries.title: Numbers 12:10
segments: And the cloud moved from the tabernacle. And behold! Miriam [became] leprous, as snow. And Aaron looked on Miriam, and behold, [she was] leprous.

entries.title: Numbers 12:11
segments: And Aaron said to Moses, Oh, my lord, I beg you, do not lay upon us the sin in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

entries.title: Numbers 12:12
segments: Let her not be like one dead, of whom the flesh is half gone when he comes out of his mother's womb.

entries.title: Numbers 12:13
segments: And Moses cried to the LORD saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech You.

entries.title: Numbers 12:14
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received.

entries.title: Numbers 12:15
segments: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days. And the people did not pull up until Miriam was brought in.

entries.title: Numbers 12:16
segments: And afterward the people moved from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
